measurement.colour_space: exact 8-bit display-sRGB PNG samples (stdlib decoder; no Blender reload conversion)
measurement.scale: ROIs bilinear-resampled so the physical reference projects to H=256 px; source H>=180 px
measurement.neutral_adaptation: saturation measured after linear-RGB channel adaptation from a co-planar neutral card
measurement.fuzz_rms_y255: RMS of luma minus a 9-pixel Gaussian kernel; median of three 64x64 px (at H=256) flat-patch ROIs when fuzz_rois_px is present, else the single patch ROI
measurement.sheen_p90_p50: P90/P50 of positive luma/(31-pixel Gaussian form blur) residuals; median of three sphere ROIs fully inside the key-lit side when sheen_rois_px is present, else the single sphere highlight ROI
measurement.patch_rule: VISUAL_TARGET common setup step 3 (>=2/3 patches in range, no miss >20%) plus median in range
measurement.saturation: (max-min)/max; retention is patch S50 divided by input-colour saturation

fuzz_rms_y255.rule: median in range AND >=2/3 patches in range AND no patch misses its nearest limit by >20%
